title: ESPERANZA II: crew-time-constrained bioregenerative food system for a 500-sol Mars surface mission — preprint v1, 14-sol meal plan workbooks and reconciliation scripts
description:
Open post-challenge release of the ESPERANZA II design (NASA Mars to Table Challenge 2026, solo entry, submitted 11 August 2026). Includes the preprint Crew time as the binding constraint of a bioregenerative food system for a fifteen-person, 500-sol Mars surface mission: design reconciliation and a 14-sol meal plan (v1, 18 pp.), the 14-sol meal-plan workbooks as submitted (schedule and lifecycle, 1,004 ingredient lines), the scripts that recompute galley labour (15.40 h per sol; worst rolling five-sol window 80.3 h; specialists 79.5–81.2 h of 90 h) and Earth-provisioned energy (41.2 % per-ingredient audit; 47.0 % crop-nameplate basis) from those workbooks, the paper figures, and the submitted Solution Summary, Concept of Operations with appendix and Design Layout.

System: 373 m² LED sole-source crop canopy, 40 m² cyanobacterial photobioreactor, 48 m² Tenebrio molitor rearing, 50 m² fungal culture; 58.1 kW mean electrical demand; 644 L per sol canopy transpiration recovered at 98.5 %; 20.7 kg CO₂ per sol fixed; oxygen release 116 % of crew demand; 78 distinct meals per 14-sol rotation.

Project site: https://esperanzaresearch.com · Preprint landing page: https://esperanzaresearch.com/paper/
notes: Preprint v1, 11 September 2026. Design developed for and submitted to the NASA Mars to Table Challenge 2026 (solo entry; not selected as finalist). Documents, data and figures CC BY 4.0; scripts MIT.
